"""
Complete financial model: DCF valuation + sensitivity + tornado + scenario analysis
for NovaTech Industries (sample mid-cap software/industrial company).

Built on the creating-financial-models skill's DCFModel and SensitivityAnalyzer.
"""

import csv
import os
import sys

import numpy as np

# --- Load the skill's model engines -------------------------------------------
SKILL_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                         ".codex", "skills", "creating-financial-models")
sys.path.insert(0, SKILL_DIR)

from dcf_model import DCFModel  # noqa: E402
from sensitivity_analysis import SensitivityAnalyzer  # noqa: E402

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. MODEL SETUP / INPUTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COMPANY = "NovaTech Industries"
HIST_YEARS = [2022, 2023, 2024]
REVENUE_HIST = [850.0, 1020.0, 1210.0]   # $M
EBITDA_HIST = [165.0, 205.0, 250.0]      # $M
CAPEX_HIST = [45.0, 52.0, 60.0]          # $M
NWC_HIST = [85.0, 102.0, 121.0]          # $M

GROWTH = [0.18, 0.14, 0.10, 0.07, 0.05]  # FY2025-29 revenue growth
MARGIN = [0.220, 0.225, 0.230, 0.230, 0.230]
TAX_RATE = 0.24
CAPEX_PCT = 0.05
NWC_PCT = 0.10
TERMINAL_GROWTH = 0.030

# WACC inputs
RF, BETA, MRP = 0.042, 1.15, 0.065
COST_DEBT, DE = 0.050, 0.45

# Capital structure / equity bridge
NET_DEBT = 320.0   # $M (debt 380 - cash 60)
SHARES = 48.0      # M shares

EXIT_MULTIPLE = 11.0  # EV/EBITDA for the alternative terminal method


def build_base_model():
    """Construct and fully value the base-case DCF model."""
    m = DCFModel(COMPANY)
    m.set_historical_financials(REVENUE_HIST, EBITDA_HIST, CAPEX_HIST, NWC_HIST, HIST_YEARS)
    m.set_assumptions(
        projection_years=5,
        revenue_growth=GROWTH,
        ebitda_margin=MARGIN,
        tax_rate=TAX_RATE,
        capex_percent=[CAPEX_PCT] * 5,
        nwc_percent=[NWC_PCT] * 5,
        terminal_growth=TERMINAL_GROWTH,
    )
    m.calculate_wacc(RF, BETA, MRP, COST_DEBT, DE, TAX_RATE)
    m.project_cash_flows()
    m.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
    m.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=NET_DEBT, shares_outstanding=SHARES)
    return m


model = build_base_model()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. REPORT
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def fmt(x, dec=0):
    return f"{x:,.{dec}f}"


def pct(x, dec=1):
    return f"{x * 100:.{dec}f}%"


lines = []
lines.append("=" * 78)
lines.append(f"FINANCIAL MODEL — DISCOUNTED CASH FLOW VALUATION")
lines.append(f"Company: {COMPANY}")
lines.append("=" * 78)

# --- Inputs / WACC build -----------------------------------------------------
lines.append("\n1) WACC BUILD-UP")
lines.append("-" * 78)
wc = model.wacc_components
lines.append(f"   Risk-free rate ................ {pct(wc['risk_free_rate'])}")
lines.append(f"   Equity beta ................... {wc['beta']:.2f}")
lines.append(f"   Equity market risk premium .... {pct(wc['market_premium'])}")
lines.append(f"   Cost of equity (CAPM) ......... {pct(wc['cost_of_equity'])}")
lines.append(f"   Pre-tax cost of debt .......... {pct(wc['cost_of_debt'])}")
lines.append(f"   Debt / (Debt+Equity) .......... {pct(wc['debt_weight'])}")
lines.append(f"   Equity / (Debt+Equity) ........ {pct(wc['equity_weight'])}")
lines.append(f"   Tax rate ...................... {pct(wc['tax_rate'])}")
lines.append(f"   >>> WACC = {pct(wc['wacc'], 2)}")

# --- Projections -------------------------------------------------------------
p = model.projections
proj = model.assumptions
lines.append("\n2) FIVE-YEAR PROJECTIONS ($M)")
lines.append("-" * 78)
hdr = f"   {'Metric':<16}" + "".join(f"{2025 + i:>10}" for i in range(5))
lines.append(hdr)
rows = [
    ("Revenue", p["revenue"], "{:,.0f}"),
    ("EBITDA", p["ebitda"], "{:,.0f}"),
    ("EBIT", p["ebit"], "{:,.0f}"),
    ("NOPAT", p["nopat"], "{:,.0f}"),
    ("Capex", p["capex"], "{:,.0f}"),
    ("NWC change", p["nwc_change"], "{:,.0f}"),
    ("FCF", p["fcf"], "{:,.0f}"),
]
for name, vals, fmt_ in rows:
    lines.append(f"   {name:<16}" + "".join(f"{fmt_.format(v):>10}" for v in vals))
lines.append(
    f"   {'FCF margin':<16}"
    + "".join(f"{(p['fcf'][i] / p['revenue'][i]) * 100:>9.1f}%" for i in range(5))
)
avg_growth = np.mean(proj["revenue_growth"])
avg_margin = np.mean(proj["ebitda_margin"])
lines.append(f"\n   Avg revenue growth: {pct(avg_growth)} | Avg EBITDA margin: {pct(avg_margin)}")

# --- Valuation ---------------------------------------------------------------
v = model.valuation_results
lines.append("\n3) VALUATION (perpetuity-growth terminal value)")
lines.append("-" * 78)
lines.append(f"   PV of projected FCFs ............... ${fmt(v['pv_fcf'])}M")
lines.append(f"   Terminal value (Gordon growth) ..... ${fmt(v['terminal_value'])}M")
lines.append(f"   PV of terminal value ............... ${fmt(v['pv_terminal'])}M")
lines.append(f"   Terminal value % of EV ............. {v['terminal_percent']:.1f}%")
lines.append(f"   ENTERPRISE VALUE ................... ${fmt(v['enterprise_value'])}M")
eq = model.valuation_results
lines.append(f"   Net debt ........................... $({fmt(NET_DEBT)})M")
lines.append(f"   EQUITY VALUE ....................... ${fmt(eq['equity_value'])}M")
lines.append(f"   Shares outstanding ................. {fmt(SHARES)}M")
lines.append(f"   VALUE PER SHARE .................... ${eq['value_per_share']:.2f}")

# --- Alternative terminal method ---------------------------------------------
model2 = build_base_model()  # fresh copy for the exit-multiple valuation
model2.project_cash_flows()
model2.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="multiple", exit_multiple=EXIT_MULTIPLE)
model2.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=NET_DEBT, shares_outstanding=SHARES)
v2 = model2.valuation_results
lines.append("\n4) ALTERNATIVE TERMINAL METHOD (cross-check)")
lines.append("-" * 78)
lines.append(f"   Exit multiple ...................... {EXIT_MULTIPLE:.1f}x EV/EBITDA")
lines.append(f"   Terminal value ..................... ${fmt(v2['terminal_value'])}M")
lines.append(f"   ENTERPRISE VALUE ................... ${fmt(v2['enterprise_value'])}M")
lines.append(f"   VALUE PER SHARE .................... ${v2['value_per_share']:.2f}")
lines.append(f"   Implied exit multiple (growth mtd) . {v['terminal_value'] / p['ebitda'][-1]:.1f}x")

# --- Two-way sensitivity -----------------------------------------------------
wacc_range = [0.080, 0.085, 0.090, wc["wacc"], 0.100, 0.105, 0.110]
g_range = [0.020, 0.025, 0.030, 0.035, 0.040, 0.045]
sens = model.sensitivity_analysis("wacc", wacc_range, "growth", g_range)
lines.append("\n5) TWO-WAY SENSITIVITY — ENTERPRISE VALUE ($M)")
lines.append("   Rows: WACC | Columns: terminal growth")
lines.append("-" * 78)
lines.append(f"   {'WACC':<9}" + "".join(f"{g * 100:>10.1f}%" for g in g_range))
for i, w in enumerate(wacc_range):
    lines.append(f"   {w * 100:<8.1f}%" + "".join(f"{sens[i, j]:>10,.0f}" for j in range(len(g_range))))

# --- Tornado -----------------------------------------------------------------
model3 = build_base_model()  # fresh base model for tornado
analyzer = SensitivityAnalyzer(model3)


def recompute_ev():
    model3.project_cash_flows()
    model3.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
    return model3.valuation_results["enterprise_value"]


base_wacc = model3.wacc_components["wacc"]
tornado_vars = {
    "WACC": {
        "base": base_wacc, "low": 0.080, "high": 0.105,
        "update_func": lambda x: model3.wacc_components.__setitem__("wacc", x),
    },
    "Terminal growth": {
        "base": TERMINAL_GROWTH, "low": 0.020, "high": 0.040,
        "update_func": lambda x: model3.assumptions.__setitem__("terminal_growth", x),
    },
    "EBITDA margin": {
        "base": avg_margin, "low": 0.20, "high": 0.26,
        "update_func": lambda x: model3.assumptions.__setitem__("ebitda_margin", [x] * 5),
    },
    "Revenue growth": {
        "base": avg_growth, "low": 0.06, "high": 0.16,
        "update_func": lambda x: model3.assumptions.__setitem__("revenue_growth", [x] * 5),
    },
}
tornado = analyzer.tornado_analysis(tornado_vars, recompute_ev)
lines.append("\n6) TORNADO ANALYSIS — DRIVERS OF ENTERPRISE VALUE")
lines.append("-" * 78)
lines.append(f"   Base EV: ${fmt(analyzer.base_output)}M")
for _, r in tornado.iterrows():
    lines.append(
        f"   {r['variable']:<18} low ${fmt(r['low_output']):>10} | "
        f"high ${fmt(r['high_output']):>10} | swing ${fmt(r['impact']):>10} "
        f"({r['impact_pct']:.1f}%)"
    )

# --- Scenarios ---------------------------------------------------------------
def run_scenario(name, growth, margin, term_g, wacc):
    s = DCFModel(f"{COMPANY} — {name}")
    s.set_historical_financials(REVENUE_HIST, EBITDA_HIST, CAPEX_HIST, NWC_HIST, HIST_YEARS)
    s.set_assumptions(projection_years=5, revenue_growth=[growth] * 5,
                      ebitda_margin=[margin] * 5, tax_rate=TAX_RATE,
                      capex_percent=[CAPEX_PCT] * 5, nwc_percent=[NWC_PCT] * 5,
                      terminal_growth=term_g)
    s.calculate_wacc(RF, BETA, MRP, COST_DEBT, DE, TAX_RATE)
    s.wacc_components["wacc"] = wacc  # apply scenario discount-rate view
    s.project_cash_flows()
    s.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
    s.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=NET_DEBT, shares_outstanding=SHARES)
    return s


scenarios = {
    "Bear (recession)": dict(growth=0.03, margin=0.19, term_g=0.020, wacc=0.105, prob=0.25),
    "Base (expected)": dict(growth=avg_growth, margin=avg_margin, term_g=TERMINAL_GROWTH,
                            wacc=wc["wacc"], prob=0.50),
    "Bull (expansion)": dict(growth=0.16, margin=0.26, term_g=0.035, wacc=0.085, prob=0.25),
}
lines.append("\n7) SCENARIO PLANNING (probability-weighted)")
lines.append("-" * 78)
lines.append(f"   {'Scenario':<22}{'Prob':>7}{'EV ($M)':>12}{'EqV ($M)':>12}{'$/share':>10}")
ev_exp = eqv_exp = 0.0
for name, cfg in scenarios.items():
    s = run_scenario(name, cfg["growth"], cfg["margin"], cfg["term_g"], cfg["wacc"])
    ev = s.valuation_results["enterprise_value"]
    eqv = s.valuation_results["equity_value"]
    p = s.valuation_results["value_per_share"]
    ev_exp += cfg["prob"] * ev
    eqv_exp += cfg["prob"] * eqv
    lines.append(
        f"   {name:<22}{cfg['prob'] * 100:>6.0f}%{fmt(ev):>12}{fmt(eqv):>12}{p:>10.2f}"
    )
lines.append(
    f"   {'Expected value':<22}{'100%':>7}{fmt(ev_exp):>12}{fmt(eqv_exp):>12}"
    f"{eqv_exp / SHARES:>10.2f}"
)

# Quality check: balance-sheet / model consistency
proj_nwc = [r * NWC_PCT for r in p["revenue"]]
prev_nwc = model.historical_financials["nwc"][-1]
implied = prev_nwc
lines.append("\n8) MODEL QUALITY CHECKS")
lines.append("-" * 78)
check_fcf = all(p["fcf"][i] == p["nopat"][i] + p["revenue"][i] * CAPEX_PCT
                - p["revenue"][i] * CAPEX_PCT - (proj_nwc[i] - (prev_nwc if i == 0 else proj_nwc[i - 1]))
                for i in range(5))
lines.append(f"   FCF bridge consistency ......... {'PASS' if check_fcf else 'FAIL'}")
lines.append(f"   WACC > terminal growth ......... {'PASS' if wc['wacc'] > TERMINAL_GROWTH else 'FAIL'}")
lines.append(f"   All projected FCF positive ..... {'PASS' if all(f > 0 for f in p['fcf']) else 'FAIL'}")
lines.append(f"   Scenario probs sum to 1.00 .... "
             f"{'PASS' if abs(sum(s['prob'] for s in scenarios.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-9 else 'FAIL'}")

report = "\n".join(lines)
print(report)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. DELIVERABLE FILES (CSV)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
out_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "nova_tech_projections.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["Metric"] + [f"FY{2025 + i}" for i in range(5)])
    for name, vals in rows:
        w.writerow([name] + [round(x, 1) for x in vals])

with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "nova_tech_sensitivity.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["WACC \\ Terminal growth"] + [f"{g * 100:.1f}%" for g in g_range])
    for i, wacc in enumerate(wacc_range):
        w.writerow([f"{wacc * 100:.1f}%"] + [round(sens[i, j], 1) for j in range(len(g_range))])

with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "nova_tech_scenarios.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["Scenario", "Probability", "Enterprise Value", "Equity Value", "Value per Share"])
    for name, cfg in scenarios.items():
        s = run_scenario(name, cfg["growth"], cfg["margin"], cfg["term_g"], cfg["wacc"])
        w.writerow([name, cfg["prob"], round(s.valuation_results["enterprise_value"], 1),
                    round(s.valuation_results["equity_value"], 1),
                    round(s.valuation_results["value_per_share"], 2)])
    w.writerow(["Expected Value", 1.0, round(ev_exp, 1), round(eqv_exp, 1), round(eqv_exp / SHARES, 2)])

print("\nDeliverables written: nova_tech_projections.csv, nova_tech_sensitivity.csv, "
      "nova_tech_scenarios.csv")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DCF Financial Model — Corporate Valuation with Sensitivity Analysis
====================================================================
A self-contained Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation engine built to the
standards of the Creating Financial Models skill suite:

  * Separation of inputs, calculations, and outputs
  * Explicit, documented assumptions
  * WACC build-up (risk-free rate, beta, equity risk premium, cost of debt)
  * 5-year explicit free cash flow projection
  * Terminal value via the perpetuity growth method
  * Enterprise value -> equity value bridge (net debt)
  * Two-way sensitivity table (WACC x terminal growth) on equity value
  * Built-in quality checks (balancing, non-negative inputs, ratio bounds)

Run:  python financial_model.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. INPUTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class BaseYear:
    """Latest reported fiscal year used as the projection base."""
    revenue: float = 1_000_000_000.0       # $1.0bn revenue in base year
    ebitda_margin: float = 0.22            # EBITDA / Revenue = 22%
    depreciation: float = 90_000_000.0     # D&A in base year ($90m)
    net_debt: float = 250_000_000.0        # Debt - cash ($250m)
    tax_rate: float = 0.25                 # Effective cash tax rate = 25%


@dataclass
class Assumptions:
    """Five-year projection and valuation assumptions."""
    # Projection drivers
    revenue_growth: list[float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: [0.08, 0.07, 0.06, 0.05, 0.04]
    )
    ebitda_margin_path: list[float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: [0.22, 0.22, 0.23, 0.23, 0.24]
    )
    capex_pct_revenue: float = 0.04         # Capex = 4% of revenue
    dnwc_pct_revenue_delta: float = 0.03    # ΔNWC = 3% of revenue growth

    # Valuation assumptions
    terminal_growth: float = 0.025          # Perpetuity growth rate = 2.5%
    risk_free_rate: float = 0.042           # 10Y Treasury = 4.2%
    beta: float = 1.05                      # Levered equity beta
    equity_risk_premium: float = 0.055      # ERP = 5.5%
    cost_of_debt: float = 0.050             # Pre-tax cost of debt = 5.0%
    debt_weight: float = 0.30               # Debt / (Debt + Equity) = 30%
    equity_weight: float = 0.70             # Equity / (Debt + Equity) = 70%


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CALCULATIONS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def check_inputs(base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions) -> list[str]:
    """Validate assumptions; return a list of warnings (empty if all good)."""
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if base.revenue <= 0:
        warnings.append("Base revenue must be positive.")
    if not (0.0 < base.tax_rate < 1.0):
        warnings.append("Tax rate should be between 0 and 1.")
    if len(a.revenue_growth) != len(a.ebitda_margin_path):
        warnings.append("Growth and margin paths must have equal length.")
    if any(g < -0.5 for g in a.revenue_growth):
        warnings.append("Revenue growth below -50% looks unrealistic.")
    if not (-0.03 < a.terminal_growth < a.cost_of_debt):
        warnings.append("Terminal growth must be < cost of debt and reasonable.")
    if not (0.0 < a.beta < 3.0):
        warnings.append("Beta outside normal range (0-3).")
    wacc = weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a)
    if a.terminal_growth >= wacc:
        warnings.append("Terminal growth must be below WACC for perpetuity method.")
    return warnings


def weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a: Assumptions) -> float:
    """WACC = E/V * Re + D/V * Rd * (1 - t)."""
    cost_of_equity = a.risk_free_rate + a.beta * a.equity_risk_premium
    cost_of_debt_after_tax = a.cost_of_debt * (1 - 0.25)  # uses 25% base tax rate
    wacc = (
        a.equity_weight * cost_of_equity
        + a.debt_weight * cost_of_debt_after_tax
    )
    return wacc


def project_financials(base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions) -> list[dict]:
    """Project revenue, EBITDA, EBIT, taxes, NOPAT, and FCF for 5 years."""
    years = len(a.revenue_growth)
    rows: list[dict] = []

    revenue = base.revenue
    for t in range(years):
        growth = a.revenue_growth[t]
        margin = a.ebitda_margin_path[t]

        revenue_prev = revenue
        revenue = revenue_prev * (1 + growth)
        ebitda = revenue * margin
        ebit = ebitda - base.depreciation
        taxes = max(ebit, 0.0) * base.tax_rate
        nopat = ebit - taxes
        capex = revenue * a.capex_pct_revenue
        dnwc = (revenue - revenue_prev) * a.dnwc_pct_revenue_delta
        fcf = nopat + base.depreciation - capex - dnwc

        rows.append({
            "year": t + 1,
            "revenue": revenue,
            "growth": growth,
            "ebitda_margin": margin,
            "ebitda": ebitda,
            "ebit": ebit,
            "nopat": nopat,
            "capex": capex,
            "dnwc": dnwc,
            "fcf": fcf,
        })
    return rows


def terminal_value(fcf_final: float, wacc: float, a: Assumptions) -> float:
    """Gordon growth terminal value at the end of the explicit period."""
    return fcf_final * (1 + a.terminal_growth) / (wacc - a.terminal_growth)


def run_dcf(base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions) -> dict:
    """Run the full DCF and return a results dictionary."""
    warnings = check_inputs(base, a)
    wacc = weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a)
    rows = project_financials(base, a)

    # Discount explicit FCFs to present value (mid-period convention omitted
    # for simplicity; end-of-year discounting used).
    pv_fcfs = sum(r["fcf"] / (1 + wacc) ** (r["year"]) for r in rows)
    tv = terminal_value(rows[-1]["fcf"], wacc, a)
    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(rows)

    enterprise_value = pv_fcfs + pv_tv
    equity_value = enterprise_value - base.net_debt
    implied_ev_ebitda = enterprise_value / rows[-1]["ebitda"]

    return {
        "wacc": wacc,
        "rows": rows,
        "pv_fcfs": pv_fcfs,
        "terminal_value": tv,
        "pv_terminal_value": pv_tv,
        "enterprise_value": enterprise_value,
        "equity_value": equity_value,
        "implied_ev_ebitda": implied_ev_ebitda,
        "warnings": warnings,
    }


def sensitivity_table(
    base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions,
    wacc_spread: tuple[float, float] = (-0.015, 0.015),
    tg_spread: tuple[float, float] = (-0.010, 0.010),
    steps: int = 5,
) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], list[list[float]]]:
    """Two-way sensitivity of EQUITY VALUE to WACC and terminal growth."""
    waccs = [weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a) + wacc_spread[0] +
             (wacc_spread[1] - wacc_spread[0]) * i / (steps - 1)
             for i in range(steps)]
    tgs = [a.terminal_growth + tg_spread[0] +
           (tg_spread[1] - tg_spread[0]) * i / (steps - 1)
           for i in range(steps)]

    table: list[list[float]] = []
    for w in waccs:
        row_vals = []
        for g in tgs:
            # Recompute equity value under the perturbed pair.
            a2 = Assumptions(
                revenue_growth=a.revenue_growth,
                ebitda_margin_path=a.ebitda_margin_path,
                capex_pct_revenue=a.capex_pct_revenue,
                dnwc_pct_revenue_delta=a.dnwc_pct_revenue_delta,
                terminal_growth=g,
                risk_free_rate=a.risk_free_rate,
                beta=a.beta,
                equity_risk_premium=a.equity_risk_premium,
                cost_of_debt=a.cost_of_debt,
                debt_weight=a.debt_weight,
                equity_weight=a.equity_weight,
            )
            # Hold explicit-period discount rate at base WACC (common practice),
            # only the perpetuity denominator and the terminal PV change with w.
            rows = project_financials(base, a2)
            pv_fcfs = sum(r["fcf"] / (1 + w) ** (r["year"]) for r in rows)
            tv = terminal_value(rows[-1]["fcf"], w, a2)
            pv_tv = tv / (1 + w) ** len(rows)
            ev = pv_fcfs + pv_tv
            row_vals.append(ev - base.net_debt)
        table.append(row_vals)

    return waccs, tgs, table


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. OUTPUTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def fmt_money(x: float) -> str:
    return f"${x / 1e9:,.3f}bn" if abs(x) >= 1e9 else f"${x / 1e6:,.1f}m"


def print_report(res: dict, sens: tuple[list[float], list[float], list[list[float]]]) -> None:
    wacc = res["wacc"]
    print("=" * 78)
    print("DCF VALUATION REPORT")
    print("=" * 78)

    if res["warnings"]:
        print("WARNINGS:")
        for w in res["warnings"]:
            print(f"  - {w}")
        print()

    print(f"WACC (build-up):            {wacc:.2%}")
    print(f"Cost of equity:             {0.042 + 1.05 * 0.055:.2%}  "
          f"(risk-free 4.2% + beta {1.05} x ERP 5.5%)")
    print(f"Terminal growth:            {0.025:.2%}")
    print()

    print("EXPLICIT PROJECTION PERIOD (USD millions)")
    print(f"{'Yr':>3} {'Revenue':>12} {'Growth':>8} {'EBITDA':>12} "
          f"{'NOPAT':>12} {'Capex':>10} {'FCF':>12}")
    for r in res["rows"]:
        print(f"{r['year']:>3} {r['revenue']/1e6:>12,.1f} {r['growth']:>8.1%} "
              f"{r['ebitda']/1e6:>12,.1f} {r['nopat']/1e6:>12,.1f} "
              f"{r['capex']/1e6:>10,.1f} {r['fcf']/1e6:>12,.1f}")
    print()

    print("VALUATION")
    print(f"PV of explicit FCFs:       {fmt_money(res['pv_fcfs'])}")
    print(f"Terminal value (Yr 5):     {fmt_money(res['terminal_value'])}")
    print(f"PV of terminal value:      {fmt_money(res['pv_terminal_value'])}")
    print(f"Enterprise value:          {fmt_money(res['enterprise_value'])}")
    print(f"Less: net debt:            {fmt_money(-0.25e9) if False else fmt_money(-250_000_000)}")
    print(f"Equity value:              {fmt_money(res['equity_value'])}")
    print(f"Implied EV / EBITDA (Yr5): {res['implied_ev_ebitda']:.2f}x")
    print()

    waccs, tgs, table = sens
    print("SENSITIVITY: EQUITY VALUE (USD billions)")
    print("  Rows = WACC  |  Columns = terminal growth")
    header = "          " + "".join(f"{g:>10.1%}" for g in tgs)
    print(header)
    for i, w in enumerate(waccs):
        cells = "".join(f"{v / 1e9:>10.2f}" for v in table[i])
        print(f"{w:>8.2%} {cells}")
    print()

    # Quality checks
    print("QUALITY CHECKS")
    ok = True
    if any(r["fcf"] <= 0 for r in res["rows"]):
        print("  [FAIL] Non-positive free cash flow in projection.")
        ok = False
    if res["warnings"]:
        print("  [FAIL] Assumption warnings present (see above).")
        ok = False
    if ok:
        print("  [PASS] All built-in quality checks passed.")
    print("=" * 78)


def main() -> int:
    base = BaseYear()
    a = Assumptions()
    res = run_dcf(base, a)
    sens = sensitivity_table(base, a)
    print_report(res, sens)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DCF Financial Model — Corporate Valuation with Sensitivity Analysis
====================================================================
A self-contained Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation engine built to the
standards of the Creating Financial Models skill suite:

  * Separation of inputs, calculations, and outputs
  * Explicit, documented assumptions
  * WACC build-up (risk-free rate, beta, equity risk premium, cost of debt)
  * 5-year explicit free cash flow projection
  * Terminal value via the perpetuity growth method
  * Enterprise value -> equity value bridge (net debt)
  * Two-way sensitivity table (WACC x terminal growth) on equity value
  * Built-in quality checks (balancing, non-negative inputs, ratio bounds)

Run:  python financial_model.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. INPUTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class BaseYear:
    """Latest reported fiscal year used as the projection base."""
    revenue: float = 1_000_000_000.0       # $1.0bn revenue in base year
    ebitda_margin: float = 0.22            # EBITDA / Revenue = 22%
    depreciation: float = 90_000_000.0     # D&A in base year ($90m)
    net_debt: float = 250_000_000.0        # Debt - cash ($250m)
    tax_rate: float = 0.25                 # Effective cash tax rate = 25%


@dataclass
class Assumptions:
    """Five-year projection and valuation assumptions."""
    # Projection drivers
    revenue_growth: list[float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: [0.08, 0.07, 0.06, 0.05, 0.04]
    )
    ebitda_margin_path: list[float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: [0.22, 0.22, 0.23, 0.23, 0.24]
    )
    capex_pct_revenue: float = 0.04         # Capex = 4% of revenue
    dnwc_pct_revenue_delta: float = 0.03    # ΔNWC = 3% of revenue growth

    # Valuation assumptions
    terminal_growth: float = 0.025          # Perpetuity growth rate = 2.5%
    risk_free_rate: float = 0.042           # 10Y Treasury = 4.2%
    beta: float = 1.05                      # Levered equity beta
    equity_risk_premium: float = 0.055      # ERP = 5.5%
    cost_of_debt: float = 0.050             # Pre-tax cost of debt = 5.0%
    debt_weight: float = 0.30               # Debt / (Debt + Equity) = 30%
    equity_weight: float = 0.70             # Equity / (Debt + Equity) = 70%


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CALCULATIONS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def check_inputs(base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions) -> list[str]:
    """Validate assumptions; return a list of warnings (empty if all good)."""
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if base.revenue <= 0:
        warnings.append("Base revenue must be positive.")
    if not (0.0 < base.tax_rate < 1.0):
        warnings.append("Tax rate should be between 0 and 1.")
    if len(a.revenue_growth) != len(a.ebitda_margin_path):
        warnings.append("Growth and margin paths must have equal length.")
    if any(g < -0.5 for g in a.revenue_growth):
        warnings.append("Revenue growth below -50% looks unrealistic.")
    if not (-0.03 < a.terminal_growth < a.cost_of_debt):
        warnings.append("Terminal growth must be < cost of debt and reasonable.")
    if not (0.0 < a.beta < 3.0):
        warnings.append("Beta outside normal range (0-3).")
    wacc = weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a)
    if a.terminal_growth >= wacc:
        warnings.append("Terminal growth must be below WACC for perpetuity method.")
    return warnings


def weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a: Assumptions) -> float:
    """WACC = E/V * Re + D/V * Rd * (1 - t)."""
    cost_of_equity = a.risk_free_rate + a.beta * a.equity_risk_premium
    cost_of_debt_after_tax = a.cost_of_debt * (1 - 0.25)  # uses 25% base tax rate
    wacc = (
        a.equity_weight * cost_of_equity
        + a.debt_weight * cost_of_debt_after_tax
    )
    return wacc


def project_financials(base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions) -> list[dict]:
    """Project revenue, EBITDA, EBIT, taxes, NOPAT, and FCF for 5 years."""
    years = len(a.revenue_growth)
    rows: list[dict] = []

    revenue = base.revenue
    for t in range(years):
        growth = a.revenue_growth[t]
        margin = a.ebitda_margin_path[t]

        revenue_prev = revenue
        revenue = revenue_prev * (1 + growth)
        ebitda = revenue * margin
        ebit = ebitda - base.depreciation
        taxes = max(ebit, 0.0) * base.tax_rate
        nopat = ebit - taxes
        capex = revenue * a.capex_pct_revenue
        dnwc = (revenue - revenue_prev) * a.dnwc_pct_revenue_delta
        fcf = nopat + base.depreciation - capex - dnwc

        rows.append({
            "year": t + 1,
            "revenue": revenue,
            "growth": growth,
            "ebitda_margin": margin,
            "ebitda": ebitda,
            "ebit": ebit,
            "nopat": nopat,
            "capex": capex,
            "dnwc": dnwc,
            "fcf": fcf,
        })
    return rows


def terminal_value(fcf_final: float, wacc: float, a: Assumptions) -> float:
    """Gordon growth terminal value at the end of the explicit period."""
    return fcf_final * (1 + a.terminal_growth) / (wacc - a.terminal_growth)


def run_dcf(base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions) -> dict:
    """Run the full DCF and return a results dictionary."""
    warnings = check_inputs(base, a)
    wacc = weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a)
    rows = project_financials(base, a)

    # Discount explicit FCFs to present value (mid-period convention omitted
    # for simplicity; end-of-year discounting used).
    pv_fcfs = sum(r["fcf"] / (1 + wacc) ** (r["year"]) for r in rows)
    tv = terminal_value(rows[-1]["fcf"], wacc, a)
    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(rows)

    enterprise_value = pv_fcfs + pv_tv
    equity_value = enterprise_value - base.net_debt
    implied_ev_ebitda = enterprise_value / rows[-1]["ebitda"]

    return {
        "wacc": wacc,
        "rows": rows,
        "pv_fcfs": pv_fcfs,
        "terminal_value": tv,
        "pv_terminal_value": pv_tv,
        "enterprise_value": enterprise_value,
        "equity_value": equity_value,
        "implied_ev_ebitda": implied_ev_ebitda,
        "warnings": warnings,
    }


def sensitivity_table(
    base: BaseYear, a: Assumptions,
    wacc_spread: tuple[float, float] = (-0.015, 0.015),
    tg_spread: tuple[float, float] = (-0.010, 0.010),
    steps: int = 5,
) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], list[list[float]]]:
    """Two-way sensitivity of EQUITY VALUE to WACC and terminal growth."""
    waccs = [weighted_average_cost_of_capital(a) + wacc_spread[0] +
             (wacc_spread[1] - wacc_spread[0]) * i / (steps - 1)
             for i in range(steps)]
    tgs = [a.terminal_growth + tg_spread[0] +
           (tg_spread[1] - tg_spread[0]) * i / (steps - 1)
           for i in range(steps)]

    table: list[list[float]] = []
    for w in waccs:
        row_vals = []
        for g in tgs:
            # Recompute equity value under the perturbed pair.
            a2 = Assumptions(
                revenue_growth=a.revenue_growth,
                ebitda_margin_path=a.ebitda_margin_path,
                capex_pct_revenue=a.capex_pct_revenue,
                dnwc_pct_revenue_delta=a.dnwc_pct_revenue_delta,
                terminal_growth=g,
                risk_free_rate=a.risk_free_rate,
                beta=a.beta,
                equity_risk_premium=a.equity_risk_premium,
                cost_of_debt=a.cost_of_debt,
                debt_weight=a.debt_weight,
                equity_weight=a.equity_weight,
            )
            # Hold explicit-period discount rate at base WACC (common practice),
            # only the perpetuity denominator and the terminal PV change with w.
            rows = project_financials(base, a2)
            pv_fcfs = sum(r["fcf"] / (1 + w) ** (r["year"]) for r in rows)
            tv = terminal_value(rows[-1]["fcf"], w, a2)
            pv_tv = tv / (1 + w) ** len(rows)
            ev = pv_fcfs + pv_tv
            row_vals.append(ev - base.net_debt)
        table.append(row_vals)

    return waccs, tgs, table

def fmt_money(x: float) -> str:
    return f"${x / 1e9:,.3f}bn" if abs(x) >= 1e9 else f"${x / 1e6:,.1f}m"


def print_report(res: dict, sens: tuple[list[float], list[float], list[list[float]]]) -> None:
    wacc = res["wacc"]
    print("=" * 78)
    print("DCF VALUATION REPORT")
    print("=" * 78)

    if res["warnings"]:
        print("WARNINGS:")
        for w in res["warnings"]:
            print(f"  - {w}")
        print()

    print(f"WACC (build-up):            {wacc:.2%}")
    print(f"Cost of equity:             {0.042 + 1.05 * 0.055:.2%}  "
          f"(risk-free 4.2% + beta {1.05} x ERP 5.5%)")
    print(f"Terminal growth:            {0.025:.2%}")
    print()

    print("EXPLICIT PROJECTION PERIOD (USD millions)")
    print(f"{'Yr':>3} {'Revenue':>12} {'Growth':>8} {'EBITDA':>12} "
          f"{'NOPAT':>12} {'Capex':>10} {'FCF':>12}")
    for r in res["rows"]:
        print(f"{r['year']:>3} {r['revenue']/1e6:>12,.1f} {r['growth']:>8.1%} "
              f"{r['ebitda']/1e6:>12,.1f} {r['nopat']/1e6:>12,.1f} "
              f"{r['capex']/1e6:>10,.1f} {r['fcf']/1e6:>12,.1f}")
    print()

    print("VALUATION")
    print(f"PV of explicit FCFs:       {fmt_money(res['pv_fcfs'])}")
    print(f"Terminal value (Yr 5):     {fmt_money(res['terminal_value'])}")
    print(f"PV of terminal value:      {fmt_money(res['pv_terminal_value'])}")
    print(f"Enterprise value:          {fmt_money(res['enterprise_value'])}")
    print(f"Less: net debt:            {fmt_money(-0.25e9) if False else fmt_money(-250_000_000)}")
    print(f"Equity value:              {fmt_money(res['equity_value'])}")
    print(f"Implied EV / EBITDA (Yr5): {res['implied_ev_ebitda']:.2f}x")
    print()

    waccs, tgs, table = sens
    print("SENSITIVITY: EQUITY VALUE (USD billions)")
    print("  Rows = WACC  |  Columns = terminal growth")
    header = "          " + "".join(f"{g:>10.1%}" for g in tgs)
    print(header)
    for i, w in enumerate(waccs):
        cells = "".join(f"{v / 1e9:>10.2f}" for v in table[i])
        print(f"{w:>8.2%} {cells}")
    print()

    # Quality checks
    print("QUALITY CHECKS")
    ok = True
    if any(r["fcf"] <= 0 for r in res["rows"]):
        print("  [FAIL] Non-positive free cash flow in projection.")
        ok = False
    if res["warnings"]:
        print("  [FAIL] Assumption warnings present (see above).")
        ok = False
    if ok:
        print("  [PASS] All built-in quality checks passed.")
    print("=" * 78)


def main() -> int:
    base = BaseYear()
    a = Assumptions()
    res = run_dcf(base, a)
    sens = sensitivity_table(base, a)
    print_report(res, sens)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
